articles.title: OnEMI Tech IPO subscribed 60% on day 2; QIB portion fully subscribed
articles.snippet: OnEMI Tech IPO shares are proposed to be listed on both BSE and NSE on May 8, while the allotment will be finalised on May 6.
articles.author: Moneycontrol News
articles.description: OnEMI Tech IPO shares are proposed to be listed on both BSE and NSE on May 8, while the allotment will be finalised on May 6.
articles.body: OnEMI Technology Solutions initial public offering (IPO) was subscribed 60 percent on the second day of bidding on Monday. The issue received bids for 2.38 crore shares against 3.97 crore shares on offer, according to the NSE data.    The portion for Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) was fully subscribed at 1.45 times.    The non-institutional investors’ category saw 50 percent subscription, while the Retail Individual Investors (RIIs) segment was subscribed 16 percent.    The company had earlier raised Rs 278 crore from anchor investors.  Check All IPO News  The Rs 926-crore IPO will close on May 5. The price band for the issue has been fixed at Rs 162-171 per share, valuing the company at nearly Rs 2,900 crore at the upper end.    According to platforms tracking the grey market activities, the shares of the company are commanding a subdued grey market premium (GMP) of about 1-2 percent, as per Investorgain.    The offer includes participation from several selling shareholders, including Ammar Sdn Bhd Investor, Vertex Ventures SEA Fund III Pte Ltd, Vertex Growth Fund Pte Ltd, Vertex Growth Fund II Pte Ltd, Ventureast Proactive Fund II, Endiya Seed Co-creation Fund, VenturEast Proactive Fund LLC, AION Advisory Services LLP, Ventureast Proactive Fund, and VenturEast SEDCO Proactive Fund LLC.    Proceeds from the fresh issue will be used to strengthen the capital base of its subsidiary, Si Creva, to support future funding requirements and for general corporate purposes.    Founded in 2016, the company operates the digital lending platform Kissht, which provides credit solutions to young consumers in the mass market segment.    The shares are proposed to be listed on the BSE and NSE on May 8. The allotment is likely to be finalised on May 6. articles.title: KKR-backed Vertis Infra Trust to file DRHP for up to Rs 3,000-crore IPO this month
articles.snippet: Vertis’ public listing plans come amid a strong wave of fundraising activity in the InvIT space
articles.author: Swaraj Singh Dhanjal
articles.description: Vertis’ public listing plans come amid a strong wave of fundraising activity in the InvIT space
articles.body: Private equity firm KKR’s infrastructure investment trust (InvIT) Vertis Infrastructure Trust is likely to file the draft papers for an initial public offering by the end of the month, sources told Moneycontrol.    Vertis owns and operates a portfolio of toll and annuity generating road projects across the country.    The IPO could see the InvIT raise up to Rs 3,000 crore, through a mix of primary and secondary share sale, the sources added. To be sure, the deal size is yet to be finalised and may be downsized, as the trust does not need to raise too much of primary capital. The final deal size remains under discussion and may be downsized, as the trust has limited requirements for new primary capital, the source said.    Vertis’ listing plans come amid a strong wave of fundraising activity in the InvIT space, which is a quasi-debt product that can offer investors high, stable and long-term yields.    An email sent to KKR did not elicit a response.    InvITs are seeing strong demand from investors, both institutional and high-net-worth individuals (HNIs), as investors seek to de-risk portfolios from equities amid heightened stock market volatility driven by the Iran war.    Moneycontrol reported on April 16 that InvIT fundraising could cross Rs 25,000 crore this calendar year on the back of several IPOs.    March saw the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) raise more than Rs 9,000 crore through its two InvITs - Raajmarg Infra Investment Trust and National Highways Infrastructure Trust. A Rs 6,000-crore public issue of Raajmarg was subscribed 13.74 times despite the launch coinciding with the Iran war.    In April, EAAA India Alternatives-sponsored Citius Transnet Investment Trust raised Rs 1,105 crore through its initial share sale, which was subscribed 20.43 times.    Other infrastructure trusts that are planning to hit the market include I-Squared Capital sponsored Cube Highways Trust that plans to raise Rs 5,000 crore and Brookfield sponsored Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust, which is likely to raise Rs 9,000 crore through a mix of a pre-IPO fundraising round and an offering.     Vertis Infra portfolio    KKR’s roads platform in India, housed under Vertis Infrastructure Trust (earlier Highways Infrastructure Trust), has been built largely through large portfolio acquisitions.    KKR’s Asian infrastructure fund seeded the platform in 2021 through the acquisition of a portfolio of operational toll and annuity road assets from Global Infrastructure Partners, giving it an immediate pan-India presence.    It scaled up significantly in 2024–25 with the acquisition of around 12 hybrid annuity model (HAM) projects from PNC Infratech in a deal valued at roughly Rs 9,000 crore, marking its largest expansion to date.    The InvIT operates a portfolio of 28 road projects in nine states with 8,428-lane kilometres, worth almost Rs 26,500 crore.

articles.title: Subscribe for ONEMI Technology Solutions Ltd IPO; Geojit Financial Services
articles.snippet: Geojit Financial Services, has come out with its report on ONEMI Technology Solutions Ltd The research firm has recommended to “ Subscribe” the ipo in its research report as on April 30, 2026.
articles.author: Broker Research
articles.description: Geojit Financial Services, has come out with its report on ONEMI Technology Solutions Ltd The research firm has recommended to “ Subscribe” the ipo in its research report as on April 30, 2026.
articles.body: Geojit Financial Services, ONEMI Technology Solutions Ltd  OnEMI Technology Solutions Ltd (OnEMI), incorporated in 2016 is a technologyenabled lender in India, primarily offering digital loans through its mobile application for various consumption and business needs. The company operates under the brand names Kissht (digital lending platform) and Ring (payments app), OnEMI empowers online and offline merchants with seamless consumer credit solutions and EMI-based payments. Its NBFC partner, Si Creva Capital Services, handles loan disbursement, KYC, and EMI collections. As of FY25, India’s retail loan disbursal via digital lending stood at ₹2.3tn and grew at a CAGR of 21% from FY20. The segment is expected to grow at a CAGR of 22–25% till FY30, with growth driven by the younger generation and rising household earnings (Source: 1Lattice analysis). OnEMI’s total AUM grew at a 64% CAGR from FY23 to 9MFY26, reaching ₹5,956cr as of December 31, 2025, with ~49% comprising off-book loans held by third-party financial institutions.    Valuation and Outlook  At the upper price band of ₹171, OnEMI is valued at ~1.4x P/B (post-issue), which appears fairly priced relative to peers while factoring in inherent risks. Backed by strong growth in AUM and customer base, an omnichannel model, and a rapidly expanding digital lending ecosystem in India, the company is well positioned to scale. We therefore recommend a “Subscribe” rating for high-risk investors for a short to medium term. articles.title: IPO Action: Three public issues hit Dalal Street this week with 2 companies lined up for listing
articles.snippet: Bagmane Realty and Infrastructure-sponsored Bagmane Prime Office REIT is the only IPO from the mainboard segment opening this week on May 5.
articles.author: Moneycontrol News
articles.description: Bagmane Realty and Infrastructure-sponsored Bagmane Prime Office REIT is the only IPO from the mainboard segment opening this week on May 5.
articles.body: The momentum appears to be picking up in the primary market as three maiden public issues will open for subscription in the current week starting from May 4, including one from the mainboard segment.    Bagmane Realty and Infrastructure-sponsored Bagmane Prime Office REIT is the only IPO from the mainboard segment opening this week on May 5.    The price band for the Rs 3,405-crore REIT IPO has been fixed at Rs 95-100 per unit. Bagmane REIT is raising Rs 2,390 crore by issuing fresh units, while selling unitholder will be offloading units worth up to Rs 1,015 crore via offer-for-sale.    Further in the mainboard segment, OnEMI Technology Solutions will close its Rs 926-crore IPO on May 5 and make its market debut in the current week itself on May 8.    The digital lending platform Kissht operator's initial public offering (IPO) was subscribed 24 percent on its first day of bidding i.e. April 30.    Click Here To Read All IPO News    In the SME segment, Value 360 Communications, the marketing and PR solutions provider, is the first to launch its Rs 42-crore IPO this week on May 4. The price band for the offer has been fixed at Rs 95-98 per share.    Recode Studios, which sells beauty and personal care products through omnichannel network, will be the next to open IPO on May 5. The company is raising up to Rs 45 crore at the upper end of price band of Rs 150-158 per share.    Bengaluru-based Amba Auto Sales &amp;amp; Services, which operates as an authorised dealer of Bajaj Auto and LG Electronics India, will be the only SME company listing on the NSE Emerge on May 5. The Rs 65-crore issue was managed to sail through with 1.18 times subscription last week.
